question: Has gateway `2026.7.1-2` met the Windows/WSL acceptance bar to replace `2026.6.11` as the setup engine's last-known-good default?
rationale: The code change is mechanical, but the LKG designation is a release-readiness decision that source review and package publication alone cannot safely make.

options.title: Accept after supported-path proof
options.body: Record current-head Windows easy-setup, startup, health, pairing, repair or rerun, and required build/test results, then merge if the upstream report is resolved or shown inapplicable.

options.title: Keep the prior LKG
options.body: Leave `2026.6.11` as the default until the candidate has explicit Windows/WSL acceptance evidence and an upstream-report disposition.

recommendation.title: Accept after supported-path proof
recommendation.body: Record current-head Windows easy-setup, startup, health, pairing, repair or rerun, and required build/test results, then merge if the upstream report is resolved or shown inapplicable.
